notes: The page lists extendedlearning@umbc.edu as the contact. The original link now redirects to youthprograms.umbc.edu.
name: Summer Enrichment Academy (SEA)
what_you_do: One-week hands-on summer workshops on the UMBC campus in science, technology, arts and leadership, led by experts and mentors.
who_can_apply: Middle school and high school students. The page gives no age or residency rule.
pay_detail: Standard prices range from $374 to $499 depending on the course.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 is over. The page says to check back soon for Summer 2027 registration. In 2026 the one-week sessions ran June 22 to July 31.
how_to_apply: Register online on the UMBC SEA page when 2027 registration opens.
